overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by listing an election-worker appointment topic on its July 28 notice without the names of the appointees, which required users to open a separate packet; it ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 28 notice was insufficient because the 'Annual Appointment of Election Workers' topic did not list the names of the individuals to be appointed.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
